name: Shounen to Tomodachi no Mama: Naisho no "Nakayoshi Gokko"
original_name: 少年と友達のママ ナイショの「仲良しごっこ」
source:
One day, Haru was going to a sleepover at his friend Kouki's house.
When he got there, he met Kouki's beautiful mom.

The boys were going to sleep soon, so they went to take a bath.
Wait... Kouki's mom is gonna go in with them?!

Their secret bathroom playtime was about to be the first of many happenings that would change Haru's life completely...

[Translated from [url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ289671.html]DLsite[/url]]
translation:
有一天，Haru要去他的朋友Kouki家过夜。
当他到达那里时，他遇到了Kouki美丽的妈妈。

孩子们快要睡觉了，所以他们去洗澡了。
等等……Kouki的妈妈要和他们一起进去？！

他们的秘密浴室玩耍时间即将成为彻底改变Haru生活的众多事件中的第一件事……
